knobs.note: DEPRECATED (BH-6000, 2026-10-11): no effect. Every candidate PR (WAIT_CI or READY, approved on its head) now gets its own detached keyed conductor run under its own per-key lock, so there is nothing to cap and nothing is carried to a later fire. A value other than the default is named in the backstop log. Row: lane.merge-conductor-backstop.mc_backstop_max_keys

timeout on EACH per-PR keyed conductor run (BH-6000: one run per candidate). Each run's PR worker is capped at this minus 45 s, never under 30 s (BH-4918), so the run keeps time for its own fan-in and enqueue. A non-number falls back to 240. Row: lane.merge-conductor-backstop.mc_backstop_timeout_s
